newsitem.title: CANADA: Four Seasons Hotels says holders okay plan.
newsitem.headline: Four Seasons Hotels says holders okay plan.

text.p: Four Seasons Hotels Inc said on Friday its shareholders approved an amendment to the articles of the company that will alter Four Seasons' share capital structure.

The company said since it went public in 1986, Isadore Sharp's famility has controlled Four Seasons through its holdings of multiple voting shares, which carried 12 votes a share and represented about 67 percent of the voting power.
This amendment provides that the number of votes carried by these multiple voting shares will rise proportionately if more subordinate voting shares are issued.
This voting mechanism will be subject to shareholder re-approval at the annual meeting in the year 2000, when it must be ratified by a majority of the minority votes cast.

Afterward, it must be ratified on the same basis every three years to remain in effect. The mechanism is also subject to re-approval at the annual meeting after a change in control of the company or Sharp's ceasing to be chief executive.

The dividend paid on the multiple voting shares will be cut to an amount equal to half of any dividend paid on the subordinate voting shares starting when the votes attaching to the multiple voting shares is greater than 12.
The multiple voting shares and the subordinate voting shares will be renamed multiple variable voting shares and limited voting shares, respectively.
